- [USER] The user then requested a study of a section titled "Nether Paradise."
- [USER] The user provided the text of "Nether Paradise" from the Urantia Papers for analysis.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant summarized the section on Nether Paradise, stating it is the underside of the central Isle of Paradise where personalities do not sojourn.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that all physical-energy and cosmic-force circuits originate on nether Paradise and that it is divided into three concentric elliptical zones.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant described the innermost zone as the focal point of force-energy activities of Paradise, while the outermost may be identified with the functions of the Unqualified Absolute.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that the mid-zone appears static but expands and contracts through three cycles of activity, and its function is not well identified.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant stated that the outer zone is the largest and most active, serving as the central circuit point of emanations proceeding spaceward to the outermost borders of the seven superuniverses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that the space presence in the outer zone is impersonal and indirectly responsive to the will of the infinite Deities when acting as the Trinity.
